episode_summary: In this episode, Bobby Kerr discusses the critical importance of optimizing Google Business Profiles for real estate agents. He provides actionable strategies for creating hyper-local content, gathering impactful client reviews, and leveraging AI tools to enhance visibility and lead generation. Agents are encouraged to focus on unique, community-focused content to stand out in a crowded market.
